grab.claim: Arm extends/pushes block right (block sits just ahead of tip); retract pulls block left (block_right=tip-1) only when arm body overlaps it; vertical move drags any block overlapping arm cells

penetrate.claim: Arm only penetrates a block that cannot move right (wall/other block); then block is attached and can be dragged vertically
